examples.english: There are many rainy days in June. It's the rainy season, so I bring an umbrella every day.

notes:
{雨|あめ} means rain. It's one of the most fundamental weather words.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {雨|あめ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}る→降る：00839_furu⟧: to rain (lit. rain falls)
- {雨|あめ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|や}む→止む：01153_yamu⟧: rain stops
- {雨|あめ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧: rainy day
- {雨|あめ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{濡|ぬ}れる→濡れる：00800_nureru⟧: to get wet in the rain

TYPES OF RAIN:
- ⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧: heavy rain
- ⟦{小雨|こさめ}→小雨：05861_kosame⟧: light rain, drizzle
- ⟦にわか{雨|あめ}→にわか雨：06669_niwakaame⟧: sudden shower
- ⟦{長雨|ながあめ}→長雨：14521_nagaame⟧: long spell of rain

CULTURAL NOTE:
⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧ (rainy season) occurs in June-July in Japan. This is a distinct period of continuous rain caused by seasonal weather patterns.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{傘|かさ}→傘：00639_kasa⟧: umbrella
- ⟦{雨具|あまぐ}→雨具：15299_amagu⟧: rain gear
